welcome.title: Where did they stop the fire?
welcome.intro: A logic puzzle. You look, you think, you tap. No guessing and no hurry.
welcome.pictureLabel: A small solved puzzle: fire spreads from a yellow spark and goes around two black firebreaks
welcome.skip: I already know how to play
welcome.note: Takes 2 minutes. Free, no account needed.

cell.spark: {where}, the spark, where the fire starts
cell.clue: {where}, the fire arrived here at minute {minute}

phase0.title: Meet the fire
phase0.body: The yellow square is the spark. That is where the fire starts. Press the button and watch it spread.

phase1.title: One square a minute
phase1.body: The fire moves up, down, left and right. Never diagonally. Each number is the minute it reached that square.

phase2.title: Now stop it
phase2.body: A firebreak is a square the fire cannot cross. Dig one right above the spark.
phase2.hint: Tap the square with the dashed border

phase3.title: It goes around
phase3.body: The fire could not pass, so it took the long way. The square behind the firebreak burned at minute 4 instead of 2.

phase4.title: Your first puzzle
phase4.intro: You get exactly 2 firebreaks, no more. The 6 burned at minute 6, yet it is only 2 squares from the spark. Something blocked the short way. Tap 2 squares to block it.
phase4.full: You have used both firebreaks. There are only 2. Tap a black square to take one back, then try another square.
phase4.cutOff: Now the fire cannot reach every square. Tap that firebreak to remove it.
phase4.tooEarly: The {clue} now burns at minute {minute}. That is too early. Block the short way.
phase4.tooLate: The {clue} now burns at minute {minute}. That is too late. Tap a firebreak to remove it and try another square.

phase5.title: Contained.
phase5.body: Both numbers are right and every square burned. That is the whole game. Bigger boards, same rules.
